analysis:
Examined the new test file scripts/models/test_model_requant_upload.py (head 1-672). It is test-only code, so it adds no runtime provider, coordinator or wire surface. It loads upload-model-revision.py and requant.py, which are not supplied here. It also parses .github/workflows/model-requant-upload.yml (not supplied) without a YAML library. It runs workflow step scripts under bash with fake aws/python3 tools on a temporary PATH and starts a loopback-only HTTP server (127.0.0.1, port 0) to test range reads.

The fixture endpoint at line 31 and the key strings at lines 293-296 are placeholders, not credentials. The tests assert the following:
- Secrets appear only in the Check and Reserve steps of the prod-environment job, after a secret-free preflight (lines 338-370).
- A master-only ref guard (352-364).
- Pass/fail-only output with no endpoint leakage (372-426).
- Upload uses only the chosen key set and requires this run's check (428-457).
- Hash-pinned, binary-only pip installs (472-491).
- No ${{ }} in run scripts (504-518).
- Manifest checks for path traversal and hidden components, the role, sha256 and size schema, and the aggregate hash (144-194).

These relate to the integrity of model weights published to the darkbloom-models R2 bucket that providers fetch (A-004, T-012/T-027 supply-chain context). No regression is visible in this unit.

Integration must verify the actual workflow and scripts, because this parser-based test could pass while the real YAML differs:
- Legacy repository-level R2_* secrets are the default (keys default legacy, line 462). Unlike PROD_R2_*, they may not be gated by the prod environment's reviewer. Confirm the workflow restricts them to the prod job.
- Confirm environment approval is configured. This is a deployment setting outside the supplied evidence.
- Confirm upload-model-revision.py enforces the source revision pin, the template URL, and the no-overwrite (Reserve) semantics.
- Confirm requant.py's range reader bounds 429 retries and validates 206 lengths.
- Confirm no promotion or publish path exists (the test asserts none, line 518).
